question: What exalted status can a practitioner attain in relation to the yoginīs?
premises: Great accomplishment includes enjoyment and liberation
Such accomplishment makes one dear to yoginīs
This dear status is a possible attainment
inference: A practitioner possessing great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who has the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
